Use the maximum depth/certificate capture and publisher clocks as information dependencies. Require all dependencies strictly before decision minus 100ms or 500ms. Independently require the most recent depth publisher and capture ages <= 1000ms; quote certificates do not refresh stale depth. Snapshots and disconnects reset the knowledge epoch. Preserve all original decision rows with explicit unavailable masks.
controls: Preserve the completed initial-frontier replay. It has 0/7070 BTC and 1741/7070 ETH noon rows available at 100ms. Additional coverage is source evidence only, never a predictive gain.
proof: Initial snapshot quantities are known inside its finite bid/ask ranges, including omitted zero levels. Each absolute delta, including zero, reveals its exact price tick. Extend a frontier through adjacent explicitly observed ticks. At a captured best-quote update ID k, all better bid/ask prices are zero and the best quantities are given. Once continuous depth has reached u >= k, these facts remain known after later updates. Quote quantities never overwrite prices whose latest absolute batch endpoint is after k. A quote before the current snapshot epoch, or older than a used certificate, cannot extend knowledge. Both sides are checked for contradictions and crossing before mutation.
purpose: Extend known Binance depth only using absolute native price updates and captured best-quote certificates. Test sustained coverage and source identity before defining any fitted depth-model experiment.
source_validation: Verify every frozen source hash and full gzip CRC. Require exact declared tick-grid prices, futures snapshot bridge and pu/u continuity.
